principles: Roles are taken exactly from player_match.primary_role; no role is inferred.
Every baseline uses only observations with match_date strictly earlier than the current match.
Matches on the same date never inform one another.
Role-conditioned metric history contains only prior non-null observations of that metric in the same observed role.
role_match_history_n counts prior matches in the same observed role with minutes_played > 0.
Missing roles remain unavailable; they are never replaced by a default role.
No score, percentile, weight, minimum-sample threshold or fit judgement is introduced.

metric_operators.name: role_history_n
metric_operators.description: Prior non-null observations of this metric for the same player in the same observed role.

metric_operators.name: role_prior_mean
metric_operators.description: Mean of strict-past metric values in the same observed role.

metric_operators.name: role_prior_std
metric_operators.description: Population standard deviation of strict-past metric values in the same observed role.

metric_operators.name: role_delta_prior_mean
metric_operators.description: Current metric minus strict-past same-role mean.

metric_operators.name: role_prior_slope
metric_operators.description: OLS slope of strict-past metric values in the same observed role.

context_features.name: role_match_history_n
context_features.description: Number of strictly earlier matches played (>0 minutes) by the player in the same observed role.
